dtypes = {
    'MonthlyRate': 'float64',
    'MonthlyIncome': 'float64',
    'Department': 'string',
    'JobLevel': 'Int64',
    'AgeGroup': 'string'
}
df = pd.read_csv('dacomp-007.csv', dtype=dtypes)

# Compensation reconciliation function with suppression check
def reconcile_compensation(df):
    # 1. Department-level (coarse view)
    dept_totals = df.groupby('Department')['MonthlyRate'].sum().reset_index()
    print("\n=== DEPARTMENT-LEVEL COMPENSATION ===")
    print(dept_totals)
    
    # 2. Drill down through JobLevel
    joblevel_totals = df.groupby(['Department', 'JobLevel'])['MonthlyRate'].sum().unstack()
    print("\n=== DEPARTMENT + JOBLEVEL DRILLDOWN ===")
    print(joblevel_totals)
    
    # 3. Full drilldown through AgeGroup
    full_totals = df.groupby(['Department', 'JobLevel', 'AgeGroup'])['MonthlyRate'].sum().unstack([1,2])
    print("\n=== FULL DRILLDOWN ===")
    print(full_totals)
    
    # Verify totals match
    dept_total = dept_totals['MonthlyRate'].sum()
    full_total = full_totals.sum().sum()
    print("\n=== TOTAL VERIFICATION ===")
    print(f"Coarse total: {dept_total:.2f}")
    print(f"Detailed total: {full_total:.2f}")
    print("Match:", abs(dept_total - full_total) < 0.01)

# Execute reconciliation
reconcile_compensation(df)
